autoContext: Generates a Python module from a user-supplied spec, held to a fixed style/interface contract loaded from style_rules.json and demonstrated to the model via few-shot examples loaded from style_examples.json — so the output format is not left to the model's discretion. Verifies the module actually compiles, then runs a two-call diagnostic/verdict compliance check against the same contract, revising (up to 5 passes) if it fails.

intake.prompt: Workspace root directory the module will be written under:
Output path for the module, relative to the workspace root (e.g. src/mypackage/widgets.py):
Describe what this module does: its purpose, the classes/functions it must expose, and their exact signatures if you already know them:

compliance._comment: Diagnostic prose (style_findings) and the routing token are separate calls — matchText needs an exact whole-string match.

final.prompt: {module_path} matches the style contract and compiles cleanly. Type ACK to close out.
